recommendation_summary: Now: build an Excel PivotTable over the existing export table, grouping dates by year and month and rows by region, summing signed net amounts so refunds reduce sales. This week: set up the reusable report, document how to replace and refresh the export, and verify each month's regional totals against the source total. No optional stack additions are offered now. The pipeline is deferred and revisited only if an observed need such as multiple sources or unattended reporting arises.
